Practised writing repeated multiplication in exponential form and naming the base and exponent; easy questions were answered correctly.
Compared repeated addition with doubling: addition adds the same amount each time, while doubling multiplies by 2.
A mix-up about the meanings of base and exponent was corrected later when Kavya identified them in 5⁴.
Practised powers with negative bases, including why an even exponent gives a positive result and an odd exponent gives a negative result.
Next time, check the method with a why-question or a new situation.
